brief.goal: Run Tri Pros-branded Meta ads in-house: offer, creative, landing, lead handling and closed-loop measurement, with every ad dollar traced to kept appointments and signed contracts.
watch: Ads stay at $75/day until the Phase 1 spend gate is met (consent, closed loop to Meta, observability).

name: Meta ads in-house (epic)
